chunks: And in the narration of ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, he said:
There is no harm in the pickled foods of the Magians, and there is no harm in their catching of fish.

key_terms.بِكَوَامِيخِ: with their pickled or preserved foods
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or legal objection

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to consume the pickled foods of the Magians and fish caught by them?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that the pickled foods associated with the Magians are permissible, and that fish caught by them is also unobjectionable. It relates to halal and haram rulings concerning food and interaction with the food production of non-Muslims.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4158 - In the narration of Abdullah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah (as), Imam (as) said:
"There is no harm in pickled foods of the Magians, and there is no harm in their catching of fish."
